title: Budget and nutrition during the 1930s
authors: H.F. van der Velden, Faculty of History and Arts, Erasmus University Rotterdam
descriptions: The data set compares the life circumstances of the unemployed with those of the employed people in the Netherlands. The main aim of this comparison is to indicate the effectiveness of government Support Scheme (‘Steunregeling’) for the unemployed citizens.
